basis: Defined by developmental delay, intellectual disability and brain abnormalities; hypotonia does not establish primary muscle disease.
Peroxisome biogenesis defect; intellectual disability and neurologic abnormalities 1/1, cataracts 2/2, progressive hearing impairment 1/1; very small samples.
Congenital ocular motility disorder; corpus callosum hypoplasia 6/7 and axonal neuropathy 4/8 support neurologic involvement; limb contractures only occasional.
Chronic inflammation of the conjunctiva; infectious or autoimmune etiology is not established.
Benign melanocytic skin lesion with desmoplastic stroma.
Inosine phosphorylase enzyme deficiency with a defining immune defect; supplied annotations establish metabolic and immune abnormalities only.
Immune-mediated demyelination damages peripheral nerves and roots; weakness reflects neuropathy rather than intrinsic muscle disease.
Ventricular arrhythmia with frequent heart failure and associated cardiac abnormalities.
Benign tumor arising from the rete ovarii, a reproductive structure; no defining endocrine dysfunction.
Defined as isolated ACTN2-related cardiomyopathy; supplied findings are cardiac and do not establish skeletal myopathy.
Retinal telangiectasia and antibody deficiency define the syndrome; reduced delayed hypersensitivity additionally supports immunodeficiency.
CRB1-related retinal degeneration with impaired visual acuity and rod-cone dysfunction.
Tumor originates in the ovary as a reproductive organ; its component germ layers do not establish involvement of other organs.
Developmental disability, seizures and movement abnormalities are neurologic; cerebral visual impairment in 3/5 reflects brain dysfunction, not eye damage.
Inherited microcytic anemia with disordered iron handling and iron overload; common functional hepatic or cardiac injury is not established across this umbrella.
Hemoglobinopathy causing absent or mild hemolytic anemia; no common direct extrahematologic injury established.
Mitochondrial metabolic disorder with renal failure and PAH; developmental delay 3/3. Muscle atrophy 1/2 and pancytopenia 1/3 omitted by cap; small samples.
Cleft palate, proliferative retinopathy and developmental delay define syndrome; dermatitis 2/2. Hearing impairment 2/3 omitted by cap; small samples.
Lipoma arises in lumbosacral vertebral-column tissue; spinal cord occupation or neurologic injury is not established by the supplied definition.
Adrenal steroid synthesis defect; salt wasting reflects hormone deficiency rather than intrinsic renal injury, and pigmentation does not establish skin damage.
Multiple congenital bony fusions define the disorder; cleft palate has unspecified frequency and ocular findings are very rare.
Benign testicular Sertoli cell tumor of reproductive origin; endocrine dysfunction is not a defining feature.
Anterior spinal arterial ischemia causes spinal cord infarction; both vascular territory and neurologic injury define the disease.
Congenital cerebral, cerebellar and hippocampal malformations with neurologic developmental impairment.
Severe congenital neutropenia is a blood-cell disorder causing innate immunodeficiency; reduced B-cell counts also support immune dysfunction.
